_comment: WARP-2540 — registered statement shapes for the ERP SQL bridge.
One skeleton per registered statement (per SET-width for writes), as
emitted by the canonical registries in @droplet/erp-connector
(src/read-queries.ts, src/write-commands.ts), normalized by
allowlist.normalize_statement: double-quoted identifiers masked to <id>,
whitespace collapsed.
WARP-2874 — the TABLE of a qualified "owner"."table" is NOT masked.
Masking it too made get_open_invoices (invoice) and get_open_bills (bill)
— and three other groups — normalize alike, so either name admitted the
other's SQL, and any table droplet_ro can see could be read under a
registered name. The owner stays masked because it genuinely varies per
install; the table does not, because resolveTable returns the physical
name it looked up, which is the registry's own vocabulary.
WARP-2874 — the introspect section is the catalog SQL of
src/introspection.ts, both dialect families. /introspect matches on SHAPE
with no name (the caller labels each query, so a label carries no
authority); the keys below are for a human reading this file.
Pinned to the registries by
services/erp-connector/__tests__/statement-manifest-sync.test.ts:
edit a registry, re-run that suite, and copy its printed manifest here.

get_schedule_today: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."appointment" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id>
find_patient: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."patient" WHERE <id> LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY <id>, <id>
get_ar_summary: SELECT COUNT(<id>) AS account_count, SUM(<id>) AS total_balance FROM <id>."account"
get_ap_summary: SELECT COUNT(<id>) AS vendor_count, SUM(<id>) AS total_balance FROM <id>."ap_summary"
get_recent_charges: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."charge" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>

get_payouts: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."payout" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_processing_fees: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."balance_transaction" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
find_contact: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."contact" WHERE <id> LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY <id>, <id>
get_deals_by_stage: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."deal" WHERE <id> = ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_recent_orders: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."order" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
find_customer: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."customer" WHERE <id> LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY <id>, <id>
get_campaign_performance: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."campaign" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_engagements: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."engagement" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_audience_members: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."audience_member" WHERE <id> = ? AND <id> = ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_ecommerce_orders: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."ecommerce_order" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id> DESC, <id>
get_bookings: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."booking" WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id>, <id>
find_employee: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>."employee" WHERE <id> LIKE ? ESCAPE '' ORDER BY <id>, <id>

list_tables: SELECT t.table_name, u.user_name AS owner FROM SYS.SYSTAB t JOIN SYS.SYSUSER u ON t.creator = u.user_id WHERE t.table_type = 1
list_columns: SELECT c.column_name, d.domain_name AS type, c.nulls, c.width, c.scale FROM SYS.SYSTABCOL c JOIN SYS.SYSTAB t ON c.table_id = t.table_id JOIN SYS.SYSDOMAIN d ON c.domain_id = d.domain_id WHERE t.table_name = ? ORDER BY c.column_id
legacy_list_tables: SELECT table_name, creator AS owner FROM SYSTABLE WHERE table_type = 'BASE'
legacy_list_columns: SELECT column_name, domain_name AS type FROM SYSCOLUMN c JOIN SYSTABLE t ON c.table_id = t.table_id WHERE t.table_name = ? ORDER BY c.column_id
